newsitem.title: USA: Wilmington Trust silver stocks 58.2 mln ounces.
newsitem.headline: Wilmington Trust silver stocks 58.2 mln ounces.

text.p: Wilmington Trust deliverable silver stocks fell 14,797 ounces to 58,264,902 ounces in the week ended November 5, the COMEX division of the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Tuesday.
Wilmington Trust in Delaware becomes an official exchange silver depositary from January 1, 1997.
COMEX silver warehouse stocks, excluding Wilmington Trust silver stocks, rose 486,526 ounces to 131,932,122 ounces Tuesday, after seeing fresh 10 year lows Friday.
NYMEX will report Wilmington Trust data weekly until January 2, 1997 when Wilmington's eligible and registered silver stocks will be reported in the exchange's daily metal warehouse data.
